sign_off.notes:
Completed a sweep of the Shop and the Skills overview.

Confirmed and logged two bugs:
1) Shop > Sell: Copper Ore and Tin Ore pay 4 coins each while the Buy tab sells them for 3 coins, so selling beats buying (reproduced by selling 1 Copper Ore for 4 and buying it back for 3), despite the new catalogue cap.
2) Shop > Buy: 2× XP Boost (48h) shows "1.9M coins" in the row and "Total cost 1.9M coins" in the confirm dialog, but buying it deducted exactly 1,875,000 coins (balance 2,567,890 -> 692,890), so the abbreviated checkout total is 25,000 higher than the charged amount.

Verified working: Keep one of each item persisted both ON and OFF across leaving the shop screen and relaunching the app, and it was enforced for single-item sells (last-item snackbar), Sell Junk (kept 1 cowhide/feather/wool) and Sell Old Gear stacks; the bulk sale recorded correctly in Recent bulk sales; search and Quantity/Price sorting worked; Buy/Sell headers were consistent for million and sub-million balances. Skills overview: all 23 tiles matched the Skills list, Combat Skills page, XP thresholds and Total Level; changing XP through the skill debug control updated the Profile grid and the list/Combat page consistently (Mining 50<->51, Attack 70<->71, Hitpoints 70<->71), so the shared-state level reads work. Prestige trees/bonuses matched the supplied state.

Test side effects left in the build: 2× XP boost purchased (coins now 693,358), junk stack sold with Keep-one ON, toggle restored OFF, all skill XP restored, inventory counts otherwise restored. Two further observations (partially clipped Sell Old Gear preview and landscape clipping) could not be reproduced by the developer and are not counted as confirmed bugs.
